name: MatrixChevronButton
description: Tactile dark-chassis CTA button with a glossy neon-lime dot-matrix chevron pill that expands smoothly across the full button on hover or keyboard focus, uncovering a cascading left-to-right LED chevron wave.

checkpoints.name: v1: Initial AI Creation
checkpoints.description: Tactile dark-chassis CTA button with a glossy neon-lime dot-matrix chevron pill that expands smoothly across the full button on hover or keyboard focus, uncovering a cascading left-to-right LED chevron wave.

checkpoints.name: v2: Hide secondary chevrons in idle state so only Chevron #1 shows inside the resting pill, tighten outer/inner corner radii to match reference proportions, boost label weight/contrast, and refine dot-matrix density

checkpoints.name: v4: Compute symmetrical left/right padding and dynamic chevron gap from measured button width so expanded chevrons are always evenly distributed with identical margins on both sides
